name: Launch week
for: A new SaaS or web product going public: Product Hunt, X, LinkedIn, your own list.
outcome: Six videos that carry one launch from the first hint to the thank-you post, so every day of the week has something new to show.

steps.title: Teaser
steps.job: Make people curious and tell them the date. Say what changes for them, not what the product is.
steps.hook: Three words for the pain, then the name and the date.
needs: three words that describe the customer's problem

steps.title: Launch video
steps.job: The main post. State the outcome in the first two seconds and show the product once.
steps.hook: The customer's outcome as a short statement, then the product name.

steps.title: Product demo
steps.job: Show the one click that delivers the outcome. For the gallery, the landing page and replies to 'what does it do?'.
steps.hook: The promise in two lines, then the click.

steps.title: How it works
steps.job: Answer the questions from day one in three steps.
needs: the three steps a new user takes
real measurements if you quote any

steps.title: Story
steps.job: Tell why it was built as a chat between two people. Feels human, gets shared.
steps.hook: A message a real customer would send on a bad day.
needs: the situation that led to the product

steps.title: Milestone thank-you
steps.job: Close the week with a real number and thank the people who helped.
steps.hook: The number, then what it unlocked.
needs: one real launch-week number (sign-ups, votes, stars)

name: Developer tool launch
for: CLIs, libraries, APIs and infrastructure, launched on X, Hacker News, Reddit and GitHub.
outcome: Five videos that speak to developers in their own language: the command, the diff, the benchmark, the integration.

steps.title: Teaser
steps.job: One hint and the date. Keep it dry; developers punish hype.
steps.hook: Three words for the thing developers hate doing.

steps.title: Launch video
steps.job: Show the install command and the before/after in code.
needs: a measured speed or size comparison, or none

steps.title: How it works
steps.job: Architecture in three steps for the people asking in the comments.

steps.title: Comparison
steps.job: Put it next to the tool people use today, on three real points.
needs: permission to name the other tool, or call it 'the old way'

steps.title: Integration
steps.job: Announce the first integration people asked for.

name: Mobile app launch
for: iOS and Android apps launched on TikTok, Reels, Shorts and the app stores.
outcome: Five vertical-first videos: the hint, the app itself, a story, the countries and the first milestone.

steps.title: Teaser
steps.job: Announce the date with three words about the habit the app changes.

steps.title: Launch video
steps.job: Show three real screens and what the user gets from each.
steps.hook: The outcome in five words over the spinning phone.

steps.title: Story
steps.job: A chat between friends where one recommends the app.
steps.hook: The question a friend would really ask.
needs: the everyday situation the app fixes

steps.title: Where it is available
steps.job: Show the countries or cities the app is live in.

steps.title: Milestone
steps.job: Celebrate the first real download or rating number.
needs: one real number from the store console

name: AI product launch
for: Assistants, agents and AI features, where the audience has seen a hundred demos already.
outcome: Five videos that prove the product does a job, instead of showing another chat box.

steps.title: Launch video
steps.job: One continuous shot that says what the AI does for the customer.
steps.hook: The job it takes off your hands, in one line.
needs: the single job the AI does

steps.title: Real demo
steps.job: Show the real screen and the one click. Proof beats claims.

steps.title: How it works
steps.job: Explain where the data goes and what the model does, in three steps.

steps.title: Comparison
steps.job: Doing it by hand versus with the product, on three points.

steps.title: Story
steps.job: A customer's day as a comic page: before, the moment, after.
steps.hook: The worst moment of the old way.
needs: a real or clearly illustrative customer situation

name: Feature release
for: An existing product shipping something new and wanting users to notice and try it.
outcome: Four videos for one release: the announcement, the demo, the numbers and the story.

steps.title: Announcement
steps.job: The release as front-page news. For the changelog, the email and social.
steps.hook: The headline a newspaper would print.

steps.title: Feature demo
steps.job: Show the new screen and the click that uses it.
steps.hook: What you can do now, in two lines.

steps.title: The numbers
steps.job: If the feature is about data or speed, show it as 3D bars.

steps.title: Customer story
steps.job: Two teammates talking about the feature the day it arrives.

name: Offer and sale
for: Black Friday, launch discounts, lifetime deals, price changes and giveaways.
outcome: Six videos that run a sale from the first hint to the last-day reminder without repeating one look.

steps.title: Teaser
steps.job: Say something is coming and when. Do not show the price yet.

steps.title: The deal
steps.job: Old price, new price, the code and the end date.
steps.hook: The board flipping to the new price.

steps.title: The plans
steps.job: Show the plans as a menu and point at the one to pick.

steps.title: What you save
steps.job: Add up what the customer stops paying for, line by line.

steps.title: Giveaway
steps.job: A prize draw to bring new people in mid-sale.

steps.title: Last day
steps.job: Loud, one colour, one message: it ends today.

name: Year in review
for: End-of-year and anniversary posts, investor updates and community thank-yous.
outcome: Five videos that turn a year of real numbers into something people watch to the end.

steps.title: The year
steps.job: The headline numbers and the month-by-month milestones.
steps.hook: The year rolling in like an odometer.

steps.title: Growth
steps.job: One metric over time as rising 3D columns.
steps.hook: The first column next to the last.

steps.title: Where our customers are
steps.job: The map of places you reached.

steps.title: What customers saved
steps.job: The year's savings as a receipt.

steps.title: Thank you
steps.job: The biggest number as a high score, and what comes next.

name: Always-on ads
for: Paid and organic social when nothing is launching: you need new creative every week.
outcome: Five ads with five different looks for the same product, so you can test which one stops the scroll.

steps.title: Bold claim
steps.job: One sentence in giant type, then before and after.
steps.hook: The outcome as three words that fill the screen.

steps.title: Retro
steps.job: The same message in a look nobody else in your market uses.

steps.title: Us vs the old way
steps.job: Three rounds, three wins.

steps.title: Comic
steps.job: Problem, product, relief in four panels.
steps.hook: The first panel's cry for help.

steps.title: The bill
steps.job: What the old way costs each month, added up.

name: Company news
for: Hiring, events, webinars, new markets and partnerships.
outcome: Four videos for the announcements that usually go out as a plain text post.

steps.title: We are hiring
steps.job: The roles and why someone would want them.

steps.title: Event or webinar
steps.job: Name, date, agenda and where to sign up.
steps.hook: The marquee lighting up with the name.
needs: date and time with time zone

steps.title: New market
steps.job: Where you are now available.
steps.hook: The route arcing to the new city.

steps.title: Partnership
steps.job: Two products that now work together and what moves between them.
